0022600138.text: The Houston Rockets (4-0) visit the Milwaukee Bucks (1-3) in their fifth game of the 2026-27 season, riding a four-game winning streak, a 2-0 road record, and a first-place spot in the Southwest division. Alperen Sengun is out with back soreness and Steven Adams is out with a calf strain, while Marcus Smart is day-to-day with a forearm strain and is a game-time decision for Houston. The teams have not met yet this season, and Houston won both 2025-26 meetings, most recently a 119-113 victory in Houston on April 1, 2026.
